insight: Mistral raised a €1.7B Series C in September 2025 led by ASML at a ~€11.7B valuation, with Nvidia among backers.
name: Vibe
tagline: Mistral's AI assistant and coding agent (formerly Le Chat).
description: Vibe is Mistral AI's consumer assistant — renamed from Le Chat in 2026 — for chat, web search with citations, document and image analysis, image generation, and a built-in code interpreter. It now doubles as a coding agent with IDE plugins (VS Code, JetBrains, Zed) and a CLI. Free to use, with Pro, Team, and Enterprise tiers, running on Mistral's own European-built models.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on Mistral's own models (Mistral Large and others); not user-configurable.

edge: Pairs an EU-built, privacy-minded assistant with Flash Answers (~1,000 words/sec) and a coding agent across web, IDE plugins, and CLI.
pros: Doubles as an IDE/CLI coding agent
cons: Higher usage limits need paid Pro
